actions.reason: Per-hit work in bridge/native/rea_lldb_tracer.py. _record_estimate now reads argument registers inline, in one loop with one shared SBError, instead of calling _read_register for each register, which made a new SBError every time. The same loop builds the register dicts and their size estimate. A failed read still raises with the same message before the next register is read. objc_method uses a single startswith call with a tuple of both prefixes. _record_json caches the encoded '{"name": ..., "value": ' prefix for each register name in a bounded dict. _frame_location unpacks the cached module tuple directly. Outputs are unchanged: the equivalence harness showed identical output, and hits_ir ratio was 0.9841.

journal.text:
I worked on per-hit cost in bridge/native/rea_lldb_tracer.py. In _record_estimate I stopped calling _read_register once per argument register. That helper made a new SBError on every call. The registers are now read inline, in one loop with one shared SBError, and the same loop builds the register dicts and their size estimate. A failed read still raises with the same message before the next register is read. I also made smaller edits around lines 358, 590 and 620.
